Built **Nightshift — Metro Cab Co.**, a playable 3D taxi-driving game set in a procedurally generated city. Complete five pickup-and-drop-off fares, avoid traffic and buildings, and earn cash.

To play, serve the project folder with a static server—for example, `python3 -m http.server 3000`—then open `http://localhost:3000`. Three.js loads from jsDelivr, so an internet connection is required.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to drive, Space for handbrake, E to pick up or drop off, and P or Esc to pause. Touch controls are available on small screens.

Assumption: I built this as a browser game with procedural visuals and no external art assets. JavaScript syntax checks and browser checks for startup, driving, and mobile controls passed.
